Tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 (naptha/tesseract.js-core), Apache-2.0
Tesseract tessdata_fast English and Simplified Chinese LSTM models
(tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast), Apache-2.0. Downloaded 2026-11-18.
